text: Resolved: PR #223 (migrate/fmri-frame) merged to master 2026-09-11T15:52Z as 46abb70. NAMESPACE now imports only fmri_frame, collect_assay, temporal_schema, as_sampling_frame; the as.matrix_dataset lazy-load failure is gone from master. The interim Remotes pin to fmridataset@3ae565e on fix/220-followup-partial-write was NOT merged and has been dropped: it set fmridataset (>= 0.1.0) + a pre-contraction pin, which would contradict master's (>= 0.10.0.9000) frame requirement. Its src/ols_t.cpp unused-variable fix was redundant (identical change carried by #223). Residual upstream gap: fmridataset did not bump its version across the removal (3ae565e and 937e193 are both 0.10.0.9000), so no version constraint can distinguish pre- from post-contraction builds; a stale local build satisfies (>= 0.10.0.9000) and then fails at load. Worth a version bump upstream.
